documents.title: POL-U2100.02 Ensuring Academic Honesty
documents.summary: The university academic honesty policy classes unauthorized generative AI use as a violation, tells students to follow each syllabus, and sets the sanctions, standard of proof and appeal route.
documents.stance_why: The policy bans no AI use itself: it lists "unauthorized use of computer-generated text (generative AI)" as a violation and says "Some instructors may prohibit any use ... whereas other instructors may allow it when properly cited", so the instructor sets the rule and the policy supplies enforcement.

units.why: The definition lists "the unauthorized use of computer-generated text (generative AI)" among academic honesty violations, so AI misuse is classed as misconduct; P36 fits because it is a classification, not a penalty.
